details.query: 查询所有Gold会员的客户ID和消费总额
details.sql: SELECT customer_id, total_spend_usd FROM customers WHERE membership_tier = 'Gold'

details.query: 已流失的客户有多少个
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS churned_count FROM customers WHERE churned = 1;

details.query: 每个国家的客户数量
平均客单价最高的前5个会员等级
details.sql:
SELECT membership_tier, AVG(avg_order_value_usd) AS avg_order_value
FROM customers
GROUP BY membership_tier
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
LIMIT 5

details.query: 查询2024年1月的总营收
各品类的商品总数
评分最高的10个商品名称和评分
details.sql:
SELECT p.product_name, p.avg_rating
FROM product_summary p
ORDER BY p.avg_rating DESC
LIMIT 10

details.query: 订单表中一共有多少条记录
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders;

details.query: 每个会员等级在2025年的月均消费额
details.sql:
SELECT 
    c.membership_tier,
    AVG(mr.revenue_usd) AS avg_monthly_revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN monthly_revenue mr ON c.customer_id = mr.unique_customers
JOIN orders o ON mr.unique_customers = o.month
WHERE o.year = 2025
GROUP BY c.membership_tier;

details.query: 退货率最高的5个品类及其退货率
details.sql:
SELECT o.category, 
       COUNT(CASE WHEN o.returned = 'Yes' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS return_rate
FROM orders o
GROUP BY o.category
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 5

details.query: 各获客渠道的客户平均消费总额
details.sql:
SELECT acquisition_channel, AVG(total_spend_usd) AS avg_spend
FROM customers
GROUP BY acquisition_channel

details.query: 2025年每个季度的订单量和总营收
details.sql:
SELECT 
    quarter,
    COUNT(order_id) AS order_count,
    SUM(total_amount_usd) AS total_revenue
FROM orders
WHERE year = 2025
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter;

details.query: 订单评分（customer_rating）不为空的订单中，平均评分是多少
使用Mobile设备下单的客户中流失比例是多少
details.sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.churned = 1 THEN c.customer_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS churn_rate
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.device_used = 'Mobile';

details.query: 每个月的营收环比增长率（按月度营收表）
details.sql:
SELECT 
    month,
    revenue_usd,
    LAG(revenue_usd) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue,
    ROUND((revenue_usd - LAG(revenue_usd) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue_usd) OVER (ORDER BY month) * 100, 2) AS growth_rate_pct
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month;

details.query: 折扣率超过20%的订单占总订单的比例
消费总额超过平均消费总额2倍的客户有哪些
每个品类中，销售额排名前3的商品
details.sql:
SELECT p.category, p.product_name, p.total_revenue_usd
FROM (
    SELECT o.category, o.product_name, ps.total_revenue_usd,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.category ORDER BY ps.total_revenue_usd DESC) AS rn
    FROM orders o
    JOIN product_summary ps ON o.product_name = ps.product_name
) p
WHERE p.rn <= 3
ORDER BY p.category, p.total_revenue_usd DESC

details.query: 复购客户（is_repeat_customer=1）平均评分与非复购客户平均评分的对比
details.sql:
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN o.is_repeat_customer = 1 THEN '复购客户' ELSE '非复购客户' END AS customer_type,
    AVG(c.avg_review_score) AS avg_score
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY o.is_repeat_customer

details.query: 每个国家的会员等级分布（透视/交叉统计）
details.sql:

    country,
    membership_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count

details.query: 配送天数超过平均值1.5倍的订单对应的客户年龄分布
details.sql:
SELECT c.age, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product_summary ps ON 1=1
WHERE o.delivery_days > (SELECT AVG(avg_delivery_days) FROM product_summary) * 1.5
GROUP BY c.age
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

details.query: 各品类中，退货率高于品类平均退货率的商品
details.sql:
SELECT 
    o.category,
    o.product_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
    SUM(o.returned) AS returned_orders,
    SUM(o.returned) / COUNT(*) AS return_rate
FROM orders o
JOIN product_summary ps ON o.product_name = ps.product_name
WHERE o.category IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.category, o.product_name
HAVING return_rate > (
    SELECT AVG(sub.return_rate)
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            o2.category,
            o2.product_name,
            SUM(o2.returned) / COUNT(*) AS return_rate
        FROM orders o2
        GROUP BY o2.category, o2.product_name
    ) sub
    WHERE sub.category = o.category
)
ORDER BY o.category, return_rate DESC;

details.query: 订单评分分布（1-5分各有多少订单）
details.sql:
SELECT customer_rating, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE customer_rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5
GROUP BY customer_rating
ORDER BY customer_rating;

GROUP BY c.membership_level
